summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend integration testing for BarberPro (SQLite-based offline barbershop management). Ran 26 pytest cases covering auth (login/password/JWT), RBAC (admin vs atendente 403s), CRUD for clientes/barbeiros/servicos/produtos/despesas, agendamento conflict detection, POS atendimento flow (total math, commission math, stock decrement, cliente history update), pacotes usage flow (usou_pacote -> R$0 + saldo decrement), caixa open/movimentacao/fechar/lock, estoque Entrada/Saída/Ajuste, despesas + dashboard KPIs, relatorios JSON + CSV export for all 5 tipos, backup creation, and change-password + restore. Ran 18 Playwright checks over public URL: PT error on wrong password, admin sidebar shows Relatórios/Configurações/Backup, atendente sidebar hides them AND route /relatorios redirects to /, all 8 protected pages load without runtime errors. All 44/44 checks passed. Admin password verified restored to 123456.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~860 lines and mixes many concerns (auth, CRUD factory, POS, caixa, relatorios, backup). Consider splitting into routers/services for maintainability.

CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api) — for FastAPI/Starlette middleware should be added before routes for correct ordering (currently works because Starlette wraps middlewares at app level, but it is fragile).

generic CRUD PUT/DELETE endpoints have no admin check (get_current_user only). Business-wise atendente can edit/delete barbeiros/servicos/produtos/clientes/despesas — request spec says atendente should only lose Relatórios/Config/Backup, so this is likely OK, but confirm intent.
caixa/fechar reuses caixa_atual(user) which opens a second connection while another may be pending; not thread-safe but fine for offline single-user SQLite.
POST /backup uses conn.backup(dest_conn) after opening a new get_conn() but never closes the source conn — minor leak.
Login endpoint lowercases usuario on lookup; seed_admin inserts admin as-is from env. If ADMIN_USER contains upper-case it would break — currently 'admin' so OK.
No brute-force lockout or rate limiting on /auth/login (per playbook guidance). Offline app — low risk, but worth noting.
test_credentials: admin / 123456 (admin), atendente / 123456 (atendente) — verified restored after change-password test
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed rows (clientes, barbeiros, servicos, produtos, pacotes, despesas). Cleanup only for barbeiros/servicos/clientes/agendamentos; leftover produtos/pacotes/despesas remain but are prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (26 tests, parallel via pytest-xdist scoped by class). Frontend uses JWT Bearer + localStorage['bp_token'], login field is 'usuario' NOT email. Public URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Pacote usage requires usou_pacote:1 flag on the item; product stock decrements on POS. Only 1 caixa can be open at a time — tests auto-close any existing open caixa before opening a new one.
